newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GERMAN TEAM RALLIES BEHIND ENGLISH ANTHEM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMAN TEAM RALLIES BEHIND ENGLISH ANTHEM.

text.p: Wombles composer Mike Batt has penned a new anthem for the German national soccer side after an approach by team manager Berti Vogts.

The 46-year-old Englishman, whose hits in the 1970s included 'Remember You're a Womble', 'Wombling Free' and 'Bright Eyes', wrote 'Running with a Dream' and is due to conduct the anthem before Germany's match with Romania in September.
"I was very surprised to find myself writing the anthem for England's main opponents," the songwriter said on Tuesday.
"The idea felt uncomfortable for about five minutes...but goals win matches, not anthems," he smiled.
